glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 木 (“tree”) + phonetic 尌 (“to plant a tree”). Originally written as 尌; an extra 木 was added to differentiate.
senses: [shù] to plant; to place upright; to cultivate
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 樹; s_page_origin explains the simplified 树.
